name: menubar
useFor: Use for the app menu of a desktop-like tool (Thread, Edit, View, Help) where each menu holds commands with shortcuts. Build each with MenubarMenu, MenubarTrigger and MenubarContent, and the rows with the same parts as Dropdown Menu. For site navigation use Navigation Menu instead.
constraints: Site navigation links in a menubar
source: The Hoplite website's header nav items (.hn__list, .hn__top: bare labels with a compact hexagon of the hover fill) and its popups (.hn__sheet, .hn__item); the bar itself is extrapolated.

title: Menubar
description: A 40px bar framed by the quiet line holding bare 14px graphite labels; under the pointer or while open, a compact hexagon of the hover wash appears behind a label and it turns ink. Each label opens the dropdown menu's square ground panel aligned to its start, and moving along the bar opens the neighbors. A long menu scrolls inside the panel and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
